messages:
Nora Mills: Quick sync 9 — we need a tight copy pass for the three product pages (Hosted / Dedicated / Private). Outcomes: clearer engineer-focused value props, benchmark callout for homepage, and definitive inbound routing for webinar vs demo vs trial. 48h turnaround.
Diego Ramos: Agree. Recommend one punchy hero line per page + a shared economics/benchmarks panel.
Priya Shah: I'll draft the benchmark language. Suggest: 'Up to 38% lower token cost with caching & batching; P95 typically under 220ms.' Will confirm numbers with infra.
Lia Park: For form routing: capture mode_interest (hosted|dedicated|private), intent (trial|demo|webinar), company_size, email, utm. Webinar -> marketing list; demo (dedicated/private) -> sales queue. Add hidden field requires_sales=true for demo leads.
Theo (Design): I'll make three hero variants and a compact benchmark badge. Question: single CTA that opens modal with preselected mode, or three CTAs each sending to distinct endpoints?
Nora Mills: Single modal is fine, preselect mode from page path. But CTAs should read differently per page (e.g., 'Try Hosted', 'Request Dedicated Demo', 'Deploy Private').
Diego Ramos: Draft hero lines: Hosted: 'Build faster with our hosted API.' Dedicated: 'Guaranteed throughput, SLA-backed.' Private: 'Run inference inside your network.' Thoughts?
Priya Shah: Prefer more active phrasing: Hosted: 'Build quickly with hosted inference.' Dedicated: 'Predictable throughput with SLA guarantees.' Private: 'Full control: VPC and on-prem deployment.'
Theo (Design): Nice. I'll map copy lengths to layout constraints 9— keep microcopy to one short sentence per mode.
Lia Park: For analytics: utm_source=site, utm_campaign=tri_mode_launch, utm_content=[hosted|dedicated|private]. Send demo leads to /webhook/sales with mode_interest and requires_sales. Webinar signups go to /marketing/webinar with utm tags.
Nora Mills: Benchmark placement: small badge under hero + expandable methodology note in footer. Priya to provide a 1-sentence methodology (seq len, quantization, test harness).
Priya Shah: Will do. Preliminary draft: 'Benchmarks run on 8k sequence workloads, A/B vs baseline library, quantization and batching enabled.'
Diego Ramos: Page sections: Hero, Why Redwood (one para), How it works (runtime + routing), Benchmarks & economics (badge + callouts), Deploy options (three card variants), CTA modal. Keep language engineer-forward.
Theo (Design): I'll drop hero SVGs and badge SVG into the drive. Also create a compact mobile layout for the badge.
Nora Mills: Dev handoff: include form field list and utm mapping in the doc. Lia to own routing implementation. Diego/Priya to own copy for each mode. Theo to deliver assets.
Lia Park: Also recommend hidden input 'lead_stage' default 'cold' and update via webhook if demo requested.
deploy-bot: Heads up: staging deploy window tomorrow 01:00-03:00 UTC. Please tag PRs.
Nora Mills: Timeline: Day 1 (today) 9— drafts + forms schema. Day 2 9— design polish, dev handoff, QA. Target publish next Tuesday.
Priya Shah: Uploading benchmark blurb to the drive now.
Diego Ramos: I'll push microcopy .md with CTA text variations: e.g., ["Try Hosted", "Start Hosted Free", "Request Dedicated Demo", "Schedule Private Eval"].
Theo (Design): I'll add the hero comps in the folder and include accessibility notes for contrast.
Lia Park: I'll create the Zapier mapping doc and sample payloads for the devs.
Nora Mills: Great work team 9— reconvene tomorrow 10:30 for review. :thumbsup:
Diego Ramos: Thanks all 9— quick edits: make hero verbs present-tense, add benchmark badge near top.
Priya Shah: Confirmed. Ping me if infra needs to re-run tests for alternate model configs.
deploy-bot: Task created: 'Tri-mode landing copy final review' assigned to Nora Mills, due in 48h.
